connector.name: Adside
connector.registryDescription: AI agents that manage paid ads on Meta, LinkedIn, and Google Ads from any MCP client.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.adside.ai over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.adside, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer sk_live_... API key from your Adside account
